historical_event.name: Surrender of Robert E. Lee at Appomattox Court House
historical_event.description: Confederate General Robert E. Lee and 26,765 troops surrender at Appomattox Court House to U.S. Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant, ending the Civil War in Northern Virginia.

techmeme.headline: Meta releases Muse Spark, the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs under Alexandr Wang, to power a smarter and faster Meta AI across Meta's products
techmeme.context: Muse Spark built for social media apps as investors question huge AI investment

techmeme.headline: Meta says Muse Spark powers queries in Meta AI and its shopping mode feature, and it plans to release a version under an open-source license

techmeme.headline: Meta is opening a private API preview for Muse Spark to select partners, and plans to offer paid API access later; META closed up 6.5%
techmeme.context: First major AI model since 14B deal with Alexandr Wang

science_daily.headline: Scientists Discover Hidden Gut Trigger Behind ALS and Dementia
science_daily.summary: Un nuevo estudio revela que las bacterias intestinales pueden desempeñar un papel clave en desencadenar la esclerosis lateral amiotrófica y la demencia frontotemporal. Los azúcares dañinos producidos por estos microbios pueden desencadenar respuestas inmunitarias que dañan el cerebro.

big_think.headline: 3 ways to prove you're human online
big_think.relevance: Aborda el desafío crítico de distinguir humanos de IA en línea, esencial para la autenticidad digital en la era de la inteligencia artificial.
